name: HumanAI Assistant
greeting: Hi! 👋 I'm the HumanAI Assistant. I can answer quick questions about our services. For anything specific, a real person will help you on WhatsApp.
fallback: I'm not sure about that one — but a real person can help. Tap "Ask a person on WhatsApp" and your question will be sent with it.

answers.answer: Hello! How can I help you today? You can ask about our services, prices, hours, or how it works.

We offer 10 services: NRI Family Care, NRI Remote Shopping, Coming Home Visits, Personal & Household Concierge, Senior Digital Help, Wedding & Events, Relocation to Bengaluru, Property Care, Be There (proxy presence) and Business Concierge.

Every request is different, so we give a free quote first. We work pay-per-request — no subscription, no sign-up fee. Projects like websites are quoted upfront. You always approve the price before we start. (Optional monthly plans are coming later.)

With NRI Family Care we visit your parents in Bengaluru, book and accompany doctor appointments, handle errands and repairs, and send you updates on WhatsApp. We coordinate care — we are not a medical or nursing service. Monthly plans include a one-page Monthly Family Report PDF.
Our NRI Remote Shopping Assistant lets you shop Bengaluru stores on a live video call. We buy, pack and ship to you, or deliver to family. Customs and import rules of your country apply.
Visiting Bengaluru? We arrange airport pickup, get your home cleaned and stocked, and pack your trip with appointments and errands so you can enjoy your family.

With Be There, we attend family moments in Bengaluru on your behalf — birthdays, poojas, school events, hospital discharges — with your gift or flowers, live-stream it to you on WhatsApp video, and send a photo memory card.
Property Care: regular inspections with photos, repairs coordinated, and tenant move-in/move-out handled. We are not a broker and never hold your money.
We help plan weddings and family functions in Bengaluru — vendor scouting on video, invitations, return gifts and guest travel.
Moving to Bengaluru? We visit homes and schools on video, and coordinate movers, utilities and home setup.
Senior Digital Help: we patiently set up phones and video calling for parents and teach safe UPI use and scam awareness — in Kannada, Hindi or English.
Business Concierge: websites, Google Business Profile, WhatsApp Business setup, AI assistants for customer questions and admin help.
We work Monday to Saturday, 9am–7pm IST. Messages after hours are answered the next working day.
We're based in Bengaluru. In-person services are available across Bengaluru; planning, bookings and coordination are available remotely anywhere in the world.
We speak English, ಕನ್ನಡ Kannada and हिन्दी Hindi.
It's simple: 1) Ask on WhatsApp or the form, 2) we plan with the help of AI tools, 3) you get a clear quote, 4) a real person does the work, 5) you get a written summary.
We NEVER ask for OTPs, PINs, card numbers or passwords. Pay only via UPI, bank transfer or a payment link sent from our official number +91 94492 30088.
You can cancel before work starts for a full refund of our fee. After work starts, we charge only for work done. Third-party costs follow their own rules.
⚠️ We are not an emergency service. Please call 112 now (or 108 for an ambulance). Then message us and we'll help with follow-up.
We coordinate and assist, but we don't give medical, legal, tax, financial or immigration advice. We can help you reach qualified professionals.
HumanAI Concierge Services was founded by Deepa Garasangi (Founder & Proprietor). Operations and technology are led by Muttu Biradar.
We use AI tools behind the scenes to plan faster, but a real person owns and confirms every request. I'm an automated helper — for real help, tap "Ask a person on WhatsApp".

We're building a verified HumanAI Partner network in Bengaluru — flexible, paid-per-task work like parent visits, accompanying to doctors, shopping and errands. Women are especially encouraged to apply.
WhatsApp or call +91 94492 30088, or email humanai.concierges@gmail.com.
We collect only what a task needs, never ask for passwords or OTPs, and delete your data on request.
